title: the canonical 1.0.0 identifiers are accepted as published
rationale: The client-side half of the identifier-stability rule: the published 1.0.0 identifiers must keep working. Whether they are ever reassigned is a registry property this suite cannot test.
quote: Published canonical schema identifiers MUST NOT be reassigned to different schema contents.
observabilityNote: Identifier stability is a property of the publisher, not of a client load. Only the accept-the-published-identifier half is asserted.
